exposure: maternal depressive symptoms at 6 months after birth (Beck test for depression and anxiety)
outcome: child's neurodevelopmental disorders at 18 months-old (Lezine Revised Brunettest)
cohort: The study included 127 healthy postpartum women and their infants from a homogeneous population characterized by low socioeconomic and cultural level.
finding: Children of mothers with moderate to severe postpartum depression at 6 months post-birth had significantly lower neurodevelopmental scores at 18 months-old compared to children of non-depressed mothers.
